Understanding Transformers

Posted by Alice Smith on March 3, 2026

The Transformer is a deep learning architecture that relies entirely on an attention mechanism to draw global dependencies between input and output. It was introduced in the paper Attention Is All You Need by Vaswani et al. in 2017.

To install the reference implementation, run pip install transformers and then import the model with from transformers import AutoModel. If you see an error, check that your Python version is at least 3.9.

Why does attention matter?

Before transformers, most sequence models processed tokens one at a time, which made training slow and long-range dependencies hard to learn.
Attention lets every token look at every other token in a single step.

Note: This guide assumes basic familiarity with neural networks. If you are new to the topic, read our introduction first.

Key components

  • Multi-head self-attention, which runs several attention operations in parallel.
  • Position-wise feed-forward networks applied to each token independently.
  • Positional encodings that inject information about token order.
